name: aboard
description: Work with Aboard, the HR platform: see your team, time off, 1:1 meetings, tasks, onboarding, reviews, skills and engagement surveys, and request time off or add tasks from chat.

interface.longDescription:
Aboard is an HR platform for growing companies. Connect your Aboard account to ask about your team and get everyday HR tasks done without leaving the conversation.

With Aboard you can:
- See who is out of office and when, and check your own upcoming time off
- Request full or half days off, sent to your approvers just as in Aboard
- Get an overview of your direct reports: last and next 1:1, and open tasks
- Look up 1:1 meetings, their agendas and tasks, and add tasks or schedule meetings
- Follow onboardings and onboarding templates, and start an onboarding for a new hire
- Look up colleagues, departments and locations in your company directory
- Read performance reviews, skills ratings and engagement survey results you have access to

Aboard only shows what your connected account can already see in Aboard and follows the same permissions. Your company's Aboard admins decide whether the connection is available, which roles may use it and which tools are switched on. Read-only access is possible by declining write access when you connect.

An Aboard account is required.
capabilities: Check who is out of office
Look up 1:1 meetings and add tasks
Read reviews, skills and engagement results you can access
defaultPrompt: Who on my team is off next week?
Give me an overview of my direct reports.
What are my open tasks from my 1:1s?

positive.description: Identify the connected user and company
positive.prompt: Who am I signed in as in Aboard?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the reviewer's name, email, job title, department and company from the connected Aboard account.

positive.description: See upcoming time off across the team
positive.prompt: Who on my team has time off in the next two weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists colleagues the reviewer can see with approved time off in the next two weeks, with dates and duration. The reason is only shown for people the reviewer manages.

positive.prompt: Request next Friday off as vacation.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the vacation time off type and creates a full-day request for next Friday. It is auto-approved or sent to the reviewer's approvers as pending, depending on the policy, and the response says which.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my direct reports.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer's direct reports with each person's last 1:1, next scheduled 1:1 and number of open tasks.

positive.description: Add a task to an upcoming 1:1
positive.prompt: Add a task to my next 1:1 with Andy Bernard: review the Q4 goals.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the reviewer's next 1:1 with Andy Bernard and creates the task "Review the Q4 goals" on that meeting and returns it.

negative.description: Unrelated request; Aboard should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Stockholm tomorrow?

negative.description: Sensitive personal data Aboard does not expose; the assistant should say it cannot get this through Aboard
negative.prompt: What is Andy Bernard's salary and personal identity number?

negative.description: Approving someone else's request is not supported; the assistant should say so and point to Aboard
negative.prompt: Approve all pending time off requests from my team.

publication.release_notes: First release: team overview, time off, 1:1 meetings and tasks, onboarding, company directory, reviews, skills and engagement surveys.
